Add color or keratin treatment to any hair extensions booking.

Book Now

Hair Extensions Price List

Consultation

A 20 to 30 minute one-on-one session with a specialist to examine your natural hair, discuss your needs and goals, and match color and texture as needed.

The $35 booking fee is applied to same-day installation.

Outcome is not guaranteed for guests arriving with extensions installed.

All packages include 20 inch Luxe Aura Slavic hair, installation, blending, styling, and at-home care instructions. Longer lengths, varying textures, and additional volume are available at an additional investment.
